context: Tests whether the agent uses the correct pattern for error queries (--facet-values error with checkpoint:["error"] for discovery, and !checkpoint negation for error-free sessions), scopes queries to specific pages using the url facet, and avoids using the error facet without a checkpoint filter.

checklist.name: checkpoint error filter
checklist.description: The error discovery query includes checkpoint:["error"] in its --query filter

checklist.name: facet-values error for discovery
checklist.description: The error discovery command uses --facet-values error (not just a filtered query) to enumerate what errors are present

checklist.name: URL scoping on checkout/payment
checklist.description: Both queries include a url filter for the checkout and/or payment pages (values containing "/checkout" and/or "/payment")

checklist.name: Negation for error-free sessions
checklist.description: The error-free query uses !checkpoint:["error"] (negation on checkpoint) rather than a separate filter approach

checklist.name: No series added
checklist.description: Neither query includes a --series flag (only page view counts are requested)

checklist.name: No unfiltered error facet
checklist.description: The script does NOT use the error facet in a query without also including checkpoint:["error"]

checklist.name: Dynamic dates, 14-day range
checklist.description: Dates are computed dynamically using shell date commands and span 14 days ending yesterday

checklist.name: Negation on supported facet
checklist.description: Negation (!) is only applied to a facet that supports it (url, userAgent, checkpoint, or error) — not to an unsupported facet like fill.source or enter.source
